limitations: This is a bounded sampled review, not full independent validation of levels 3001-4000. Twelve distinct original board.jpg images were rendered and visually inspected; no sheet preparation or structural result was treated as visual evidence.

Selection used first, middle (zero-based available-row count divided by two), and last available rows in each of the four shards: 3001/3127/3252, 3253/3379/3504, 3505/3631/3756, and 3757/3884/4000. Missing levels 3776-3785 were excluded when computing the last shard's available-row midpoint.
validation.json has no repeated_observations entries, so there were no additional highlighted repeated-category descriptions to sample. Wording diversity was not used as correctness evidence.

Counts: 9 supported, 1 conflict, 2 uncertain. Supported means the sampled visible claims are consistent, not that tags are exhaustive or blocker identities and mechanics are independently established. No unsupported geometry tag was invented to force a conflict; the concrete conflict at 3505 concerns concealment and visibility classification.

Green curtains prevent verification of hidden board extent and connectivity at 3252 and 3505. A source-resolution still does not remove those curtains. Central covered-cell semantics remain uncertain at 3253.

All twelve sampled difficulty_hypothesis and strategy_hypothesis fields are null. There were no non-null hypotheses in this sample to test for image specificity or generic category wording, and no measured difficulty or optimal strategy is inferred.

Blocker names are descriptive visual references, not verified mechanic identifications. Empty background gaps, occupied blocked cells, stepped play outlines, central fixture masses, and non-arena cell arrangements were assessed separately.

Candidate corrections are review proposals only. Original candidate observations and classifications are preserved alongside the observed disagreements in this report; shards, trackers, source images and app state were not edited. No labels are accepted.
